title: MoRTH to Organise ‘Transport Mela’ under PARIVARTAN Scheme in Delhi-NCR on 28th October, 2026
subtitle:
Old truck and bus owners to get on-the-spot guidance on scrapping, financing and purchase of cleaner replacement vehicles
Vehicle manufacturers and their dealers, registered vehicle scrapping facilities, banks, oil marketing companies and other stakeholders to come together at a single location to facilitate vehicle owners
body_text: The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH), in collaboration with the Government of Delhi, is organising a Transport Mela under the PARIVARTAN Scheme at the Vehicle Inspection Unit, near the District Transport Office (DTO), Burari, North Delhi, on 28 October 2026, from 9:30 AM onwards. Vehicle Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and their dealers, Registered Vehicle Scrapping Facilities (RVSFs), banks and Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs), Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs), and City Gas Distribution (CGD) entities associated with the Scheme will participate in the Mela. Their representatives will provide information, guidance and assistance relating to vehicle scrapping, financing options, purchase of replacement vehicles, fuel-related benefits and other applicable incentives. Through the PARIVARTAN Scheme, the Government is promoting the replacement of old trucks and buses in Delhi-NCR with cleaner vehicles by providing various incentives, including a minimum 8% discount from OEM discount, 5% interest subvention on vehicle loans, 100% road tax concession for 10 years, one-time benefits for electric vehicles (EVs), monthly fuel vouchers and waiver of registration fees, as applicable. As on date, about 40,000 beneficiaries have registered on the PARIVARTAN portal. Venue of the Mela: Vehicle Inspection Unit, near DTO, Burari, North Delhi Date: 28 October 2026 Time: 9:30 AM onwards *** GDH/DS
